about.fights: an offer: a sighting (the enemy in view after 1 s or more out of it). Takes it: within 3 s he deals damage (a step of his hit counter) or is 150 units or more nearer to the enemy than at the sighting (at the last moment of the 3 s the enemy's place is known). Refuses it: neither of those, and the enemy is out of his view for 0.5 s at a stretch or he is 150 or more farther. How it goes: the damage he deals is counted from his hits (rocket 70, rail 80, a lightning cell 6, machine gun 5, a shotgun shell 40, grenade 60, plasma 20: a demo has no damage numbers), the damage he takes is his own health and armor going down; frags from the game's death notices (exact, also after a cut of the demo); a big item (mega, red, yellow armor) for him within 15 s, and for the enemy only where the server sent the enemy's pickup. The enemy's stack is a guess (enemy_estimate): 125 at his spawn, less the counted damage of his hits, more by pickups seen or heard, rising toward the pros' own stack by time since a spawn while unseen; checked at the demos' cuts to the other player (enemy_stack_guess_check). The index of a situation: taken / (taken + refused); index_model gives it for any mix of the sides as a logistic formula. 'Commits': he takes it and after the 3 s the view was never broken for 0.5 s, he is not 150 farther and he lives (commits_share is of all offers; commit_model is its formula); 'fires and leaves' is the rest of the taken ones. 'Taking pays': frags for less frags of him within 10 s when taken, less the same when refused
about.flick_curve: an appearance: a clear line to the enemy opens after 1 s or more without one, wherever his view points (the sightings elsewhere need the enemy inside the 55 degree cone; here the angle runs to 180). The weapon is that of his first shot within 3 s, else the one in his hand. Hits as in hit_combinations; of the first 0.5 s of fire: the shots of that weapon from his first shot on for 0.5 s and the hits of those shots
about.view_travelling: his view against the direction of his velocity while he moves at 350 or more with no enemy in view; and on every 16th such frame: his view within 20 degrees of one of the map's places (sim/pro_places) with a clear line to it and under 3000 units, and of 'the doorway': the first spot on the walking map's quickest way from where he last saw the enemy to himself that he has a clear line to (the place itself if he has a clear line to it)
about.openings: a life begins within 100 units of a spawn point: the game's first frame, or the frame he is alive again. Its plan: the first three different items of weapons, armors (red, yellow, green) and the mega he takes in the next 15 s (a weapon: its ammunition rising at its spot), in their order. The killer's weapon and place: the enemy's in the 2 s before his death, where the demo has them. Frags within 30 s from the game's death notices. After a frag of his: the same plan from the frag on; 'his view on a spawn point': within 20 degrees of one with a clear line, from 2 to 6 s after the frag (the enemy is back after about 2.1 s). The files sim/pro_openings/<map>.json hold the plans a spawn point
about.sounds: a sound: a new event on the enemy's entity while the server sends him (a jump, a jump pad, a shot by weapon, a pickup by kind), or his teleporter event; a stream of lightning, machine gun or plasma counts once, at its start. Counted when the enemy has been out of view for a second or more at that moment. His view's angle to the sound's place then, 1 s and 2 s later (the difference is the degrees gained); his way turned: the direction of his velocity differs by over 60 degrees (both speeds over 100); a blind shot toward it: a shot within 2 s with nobody in view and his view within 20 degrees of the sound's place. The baseline: every 20th frame with the enemy's place known, out of view for a second or more, and none of these sounds of his within a second either side (his steps on the ground are not among the kinds: they may be heard); the same numbers toward the enemy's place. 'all' is the sounds within 1200 units; the bands by distance hold the farther ones too
about.weapon_in_hand: his time with no enemy in view, by the weapon in his hand: travelling (200 units a second or more, outside a hold) and holding (the holds group). Rail and lightning hum in the hand; the others are silent. By how long ago the enemy was in view, how far he is from where he last saw him, his stack. The shots: with nobody in view for 1 s or more, a minute of that time
about.teleporters: a trip: a step in one frame that no movement makes (over 100 units and over four times his speed times the frame), to within 120 units of a teleporter's exit. The speed in: on the frame before; out: two frames after (medians from bands of 10). A jump as he comes out: 150 or more upward speed within 0.2 s. High take-offs: he leaves the ground with 300 to 480 upward speed, no rocket, grenade or plasma shot of his and no damage to him in the 0.3 s before, no teleporter (a plain jump gives 275). Take-offs on his own weapon: 300 or more upward speed with his rocket, grenade or plasma in the 0.3 s before. Plain jumps that come down 50 or more higher: the landing against the take-off, no weapon, damage, pad or teleporter on the way (the plain jump's top is 47 units: a step was taken in the air); plain_jumps_landing_higher_by is the share of the plain jumps that come down level or higher, by 8 units. The files sim/pro_tele_jumps/<map>.json list the teleporters, the landings only the jump reaches and the places of these take-offs
